_why: W18-DENSITY-B4-B5, 2026-09-04 (CL-O4 density half; docs/FINISH_THE_MEADOWS_ADDENDUM_2026-09-04.md sections B/C; docs/owner/OWNER_DIRECTIVES_2026-09-04-C.md sections 2-3). One-time world finds for the Upper Meadows, loaded by scripts/world/band_pickups.gd and persisted by `id` (the once-flag; one identity per authored location, so a reload cannot mint a second copy). `tier` is the addendum's placement logic: critical = on the road, sparse and Good; side = ordinary side exploration, Good; detour = a loop or a named point of interest, Great; secret = a memorable landmark, a deep branch or the hardest optional encounter, Rare. Recovery items are sited BEFORE the attrition they support (the two captains, the rest-free ridge climb of P-4.1, the seam into the approach), never after it, and never inside a camp. Every position was probed on the real world (tools/_probe_band_density.gd: Terrain3D ground, 2m pad slope/spread, solid scatter, river, prompt separation >= 4.5m from every harvest node and pickup). Positions are [x, z]; y comes from the ground.

pickups.why: The band's doorstep, 20m off the road beside the (-56,4818) Ironwood pair the seam rhythm opens with: the first candy after the river says the Upper Meadows pays for looking.
The old-growth's second bend, between the two mudsnout wallows (orders 4017/4018), on the road itself -- the addendum's 'critical path: sparse, mostly Good'.
At the unmanned ridge road picket (props.json order 4004) P-4.2 asks to read as recently manned -- a dropped pack's sweet is the cheapest 'someone was just here' the barricade can carry.
35m east of the road in the night-duskhush pocket (orders 4013/4014): a player who walks toward the roost by day finds the sweet, and by night finds the roost too.

Inside the Ironwood stand's crafting clearing (vegetation.json clearing 4002), between the felling nodes: the stand is the band's material tier and this says stopping to fell it is worth more than the wood.
Juno's paddock, 30m from the drover herself: the warm-up trainer's ground pays a little for the walk over, so the optional fight is not the only reason to leave the road.
On the rock shelf the burrowback clusters (orders 4031/4032) dig under, 40m west of the road on the way to Halder: side exploration on the pasture, Good.
50m past Captain Halder's ground, at the pasture's edge below the stock camp: the first Sigil fight leaves the player looking around, and the field answers.
At the hedge where the wind ridge traverse forks off (330,5700), 30m south of the fork: a sweet at the fork is the pull that makes a player notice the loop exists.
The Highfield's south paddock (map_landmarks `the_highfield`), between the ridge road and the herd: ordinary side ground on the landmark, Good.
The saddle where the ridge traverse comes back down toward the overlook, off the loop's own line: the loop's exit pays as well as its entry.
55m east of the road on the high pasture, near the TM aerial_flash's own glade: side ground between the overlook and the picket.
At the foot of the rest-free ridge climb (P-4.1), 30m off the road: the last easy find before the climb, so the climb's own sweet (a Great, halfway up) is a promise the foot already made.
35m from the ridge patrol camp (props.json order 4000), on the Ridgeline Watch's east slope: the camp's own supply spill, Good, outside the rest pad.
The run-out meadow between the trailpup clusters (orders 4056/4057), 40m off the road: the approach to the Broken Tower keeps paying at ordinary side-exploration rates.
The last meadow before the band 5 seam, 30m east of the road beside the trailpup cluster (order 4061): the Upper Meadows says goodbye with one more Good rather than a wall of nothing.
Behind the alpha Burrowback at (-285,5080) (level +4, the grove's guardian): a tougher encounter guards a Great, the addendum's 'tougher encounters, stronger points of interest'.
On the crag the Galecrest alpha (order 4001, level +3) circles, past its 20m radius: the deepest point of the old-growth swing, a Great for walking to the west edge of the band.
The far side of the Ironwood stand, behind the trees from the road (harvest.json's own 'genuine detour off the tree-line stand, not visible from the spine'): a Great for going round the back.
Halfway up the rest-free ridge climb (P-4.1 forbids a clearing here, not a find): the climb is the band's attrition beat and a Great rewards it without healing anyone.

The wind ridge traverse's crest (loop `wind_ridge_traverse`, the highest ground in the Meadows): the loop is the band's biggest detour and MACRO_LAYOUT wants it sparse so the vista lands -- one Great, not a scatter.
The east edge of the high pasture where the Meadowhart herd (order 4051) grazes below the overlook: the riding-payoff loop's own Great, 80m off the road.
Beside the severed conduit post (props.json order 4002), the band's faction evidence: a Great where Team Tether's own line was cut, so the story beat is also a reward beat.
At the rocky-shoulder den (orders 4076/4102, the tight burrowback/trailpup pocket above the ridge camp): the encounter contract's 'galecrest den (wild)' beat, a tougher fight in a tight space, Great.
In the Broken Tower's collapsed footprint (map_landmarks `the_broken_tower`, 30m radius), beside the revive and the TM the patrol never shipped: a landmark's deliberate reward, Great.

Beside the rain-gated Stormtrail's stand (order 4100, one individual, appears only in rain): a memorable secret at the band's far west edge -- the candy is always there, the creature only sometimes, and finding both is the story a player tells.
Rue's Tether Patrol at (-300,5870), the deepest off-spine optional trainer in the band (the encounter contract's own 'optional'): a deep branch with a hard fight at the end earns a Rare.

Beside the herd bull (order 4101, alpha Meadowhart level +4, P-4.3's kept block) on the Highfield: the band's landmark encounter and its riding temptation in one place, so the Rare sits where the roster question is asked.

The far corner of the watchtower spur (loop `watchtower_spur`, past Captain Vess): 'the first clear sight of the stronghold', reached only by taking the spur beyond the fight -- a landmark and a deep corner, Rare.
On the old-growth swing before the grove's alpha Burrowback and the Galecrest alpha: basic supplies before the band's first two alpha fights, 30m off the road.

On the Ironwood crafting pad (clearing 4002, not a rest): the first revive after the river, sited where two alphas and a rain-gated rare live within 150m -- recovery before that attrition, not after it.
In the night-duskhush pocket (order 4008) beside the stashed tonic (harvest 4022): a defence buff for the walk to Juno and Halder, a detour's better supply.
On the trail out toward Rue's patrol, halfway from the road: the deep branch is optional and its fight is hard, so the branch carries its own basic supply on the way OUT, before the fight.
On the road 80m before Captain Halder: 'main routes: occasional basic supplies', placed before the first Sigil captain rather than after.

45m before the Highfield stock camp (the band's one working camp), on the approach from Halder: a revive found limping TO the camp, never inside it -- recovery before the rest, the W17/W18 siting rule.
On the wind ridge traverse past the galecrest line (order 4066): a speed buff on the highest, thinnest stretch, a detour's stronger supply.
Beside the picket at the foot of the rest-free ridge climb (P-4.1): the last heal before Vess is found before the climb starts, which is where a player decides whether to camp first.
On the climb itself, 60m below Captain Vess: a revive before the second captain, where the attrition of the rest-free climb bites -- recovery arriving before the fight it supports.
At the Broken Tower's foot, 40m from the patrol's own revive: an attack buff on the last landmark before the approach, for the alpha Galecrest pack that opens band 5.
On the road 15m before the band 5 seam: basic supplies before Corr and the danger beat, the approach's own attrition, found before it starts.
